title: The Escarpment of Devil's Throat
author: Kestrel Hartwell
blurb: Zephyrine Hartwell, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
